# U115: Start 2027 only prepares it: on 21 Dec 2026 the read-back counts every goal once; afterwards everyone is still in 2026 and Cycles offers Undo, which puts 2026 back; started again, 2027 opens for everyone on 4 Jan 2027. A workspace whose only year is 2027 says when it starts and has nothing due

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `CARRY-GOALS`
- **Budget:** 8 steps, not scored: this journey’s ease test leaves `budget` out, so it may take more (the steps below are counted all the same)
- **Ease test:** every point but `budget` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U115

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- _Note:_ The example copied into a workspace of Amara's own, so it keeps 2026 when the clock moves (as U10 does).
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `async () => { const full = await window.__goalsStore.load('platform-org'); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-v2:workspaces', JSON.stringify([{ id: 'ws_turn', name: 'Year turn', kind: 'own', createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' }])); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-v2:ws_turn', JSON.stringify({ ...full })); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-workspace', 'ws_turn'); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-viewer:ws_turn', 'amara'); }`.
- Go to `/workspace/cycles` in the demo on Monday 21 December 2026.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Start 2027” link is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the “Start 2027” link.
- **Check:** “Everyone stays in 2026 until Sun 3 Jan 2027” is shown.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `counts.length === 4 && counts.reduce((n, c) => n + Number(c), 0) === live`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot('ws_turn')`; `const live = s0.goals.filter((g) => !g.stoppedAt && !g.removedAt).length`; `const counts = await p.locator('.read-back-n').allInnerTexts()`. Else it says: the read-back's counts ({counts.join(', ')}) don't add up to the {live} goals.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “read-back”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Start 2027” button.
- **Check:** “2027 is ready” is shown.
- _Note:_ Nobody moves: Home is still 2026.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Monday 21 December 2026.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `/2026 · week 52/.test(await p.locator('body').innerText())`. Else it says: starting 2027 moved everyone into it early.
- _Note:_ Undo puts 2026 back as it was.
- Go to `/workspace/cycles` in the demo on Tuesday 22 December 2026.
- **Step.** Press the “Undo” button in the “2027 is ready” section.
- **Check:** “2027 was undone” is shown.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `undone && s.changes.some((c) => c.summary === 'Undid the start of 2027')`, where `let s = await h.snapshot('ws_turn')`; `const undone = s.cycles.filter((c) => c.name === '2027' && !c.removedAt).length === 0`. Else it says: Undo did not put 2026 back.
- _Note:_ Started again, then 4 January 2027: everyone is in 2027.
- Go to `/workspace/cycles/next` in the demo on Wednesday 23 December 2026.
- **Step.** Press the “Start 2027” button.
- **Check:** “2027 is ready” is shown.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Monday 4 January 2027.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/2027 · week 1 · Q1/.test(jan) && s.cycles.filter((c) => c.name === '2027' && !c.removedAt).length === 1`, where `let s = await h.snapshot('ws_turn')`; `const jan = await p.locator('body').innerText()`. Else it says: on 4 Jan 2027 the frame said “{worked out in the journey as `(jan.match(/20\d\d[^\n]{0,30}/) || [''])[0]`}”.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.changes.filter((c) => c.entity === 'cycle' && c.summary.startsWith('Started 2027')).length === 2`, where `let s = await h.snapshot('ws_turn')`.
- _Note:_ What came with the goals (CY4): watches and open asks follow; no stage is due after week 52; no number plan starts late. A module's records that follow (metric links) are the module's own journey's to check (U152; fix item F6).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `came && planned`, where `let s = await h.snapshot('ws_turn')`; `const y27 = s.cycles.find((c) => c.name === '2027' && !c.removedAt)`; `const ids27 = new Set(s.goals.filter((g) => g.cycleId === y27.id).map((g) => g.id))`; `const came = (s.watches || []).some((w) => !w.removedAt && ids27.has(w.ref)) && (s.requests || []).some((r) => r.status === 'open' && r.goalIds.some((id) => ids27.has(id)))`; `const planned = s.goals.filter((g) => ids27.has(g.id)).every((g) => g.kind === 'milestone' ? g.stages.every((x) => x.dueWeek <= 52) : g.kind !== 'metric' || (g.plan.fromWeek || 0) <= 0)`. Else it says: carried goals came without their watches or asks, or with a plan past week 52 ({came}, {planned}).
- _Note:_ A workspace whose only year is 2027, on 11 Nov 2026: it says when it starts, and nothing is due.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `(snap) => { const c = snap.cycles[0]; const only = { ...snap, cycles: [{ ...c, name: '2027', startDate: '2026-12-28', weeks: 52 }], goals: snap.goals.filter((g) => g.cycleId === c.id).map((g) => ({ ...g, createdAt: '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' })), checkIns: [], changes: [] }; localStorage.setItem('goals-app-v2:ws_turn', JSON.stringify(only)); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-viewer:ws_turn', 'rhea'); }`, given `s0`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot('ws_turn')`.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- **Check:** (`parity`) met when `/2027 starts on Mon 4 Jan 2027, in 7 weeks\. Nothing is due until then\./.test(before) && !/check-ins? to do|days late|No recent update/.test(before)`, where `const before = await p.locator('main').innerText()`. Else it says: a year not begun: “{worked out in the journey as `before.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 200)`}”.
- Close this browser.
